name: @ce-net/db
description: ce-db for TypeScript: typed state.store collections (insert, get, update, remove, queries by declared index, live watch) in node and the browser

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples && node --test dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.example: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples && node examples/dist/quickstart.js
scripts.gen: ce-wire-gen --lang ts ../state-store-cell/crates/state-store-api/src/lib.rs -o src/wire/node && ce-wire-gen --lang ts-web ../state-store-cell/crates/state-store-api/src/lib.rs -o src/wire/web
